decision_notes: C wins through substantive specificity, historical qualification, constrained-agency synthesis, and actionable failure modes—not wording overlap. B offers stronger institutional and ideological synthesis than D. A is weakest because repetitive task-identification checks substitute for observable analytical requirements. All four leave substantial portions of the human reference uncovered.
